expect: the public example/outcome library with filters and inspectable example cards. External certified references without local images should show explicit external-reference/no-local-image placeholders rather than blank cards.

response.scene_summary: The user navigates to the 'Verified Outcome Library' page, which displays a grid of example cards. They interact with a filter by checking the 'failure cases only' checkbox, which updates the displayed cards. Finally, the user clicks on one of the updated cards to view its detailed inspection page.
key_observations: The initial view shows a library of cards, some with 'no local image evidence yet' and 'PSA CERT' links.
The user checks the 'failure cases only (4)' checkbox in the search filter.
The card grid updates, revealing more detailed information on previously placeholder cards, including 'PSA GEM MT 10', 'OUR SCORE N/A - reference only', and 'no local image evidence yet'.

Clicking on the 'Monkey D. Luffy - Manga Alternate Art' card opens a detailed view, explicitly stating 'External certified reference only; no cert images are cached and no DINGs-level grader notes are implied.'.
ui_text_snippets: Inspect the inspection before you trust the scanner.
